entities.summary: The Bovenkerk is a large, Gothic church and the most striking element on the skyline of Kampen, Overijssel, Netherlands. The interior of the church contains an early-Renaissance choir screen, a stone pulpit and a monumental organ. The church has 1,250 seats. It is a Reformed church. Bovenkerk, Kampen is a church building in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
